岗位：软件项目实施工程师
Position: Project Consultant
该岗位会常驻在南京相近省市进行项目实施交付工作；需要能接受经常出差哦！此地址为虚拟地址，总部在上海，现需要在南京招聘软件实施顾问。
我司提供很有竞争力的薪资待遇和福利：
1）你的底薪将会在税前6000 RMB 到9000 RMB左右，取决于您的工作年限和个人能力,具体可面议；
2）你将会享受五险一金、年假、公司Outing, 年度体检等福利；
3）每个项目的完成都会有项目奖金；
4）除去差旅费报销额外有出差补助，出差补贴为不过夜50元/天，过夜100元/天；
5）年底奖金将取决于公司销售额和您的KPI表现。 
We supply very competitive salary package and welfare:
1. Your basic salary will range from 6000 RMB to 9000 RMB before tax, depending on your working experience as well as personal capabilities;
2. You will enjoy welfares, such as: insurance, annual leaves, company outing, annual physical examination, etc.
3. For every project, you will get project bonus and per-diem;
4. Excluding travel expense reimbursement, there is an additional business trip subsidy, which is 50 yuan/day for overnight stays and 100 yuan/day for overnight stays;
5. Your year-end bonus will be evaluated based on company revenue and KPIs.
职责描述：
- 完成项目经理分配的工作任务；
- 协助项目经理完成客户的业务讨论、文档编写等；
- 协助项目经理进行业务调研、分析，培训、客户站点的系统部署等工作；
- 负责软件培训和售后服务。
Job Description:
- Complete assigned work;
- Assist project manager to define technical requirement of customers, prepare related document;
- Assist project manager to carry out implementation study of our system at customer side;
- Be responsible for training and after-sales service. 
职位要求：
-对维护管理系统和项目实施感兴趣；
- 本科及以上学历;
- 较强的英语口语能力和写作能力;
- 工程类专业优先，有项目实施经验者优先考虑;
- 较强的逻辑思考能力和独立完成工作的能力;
- 团队意识强，能够及时完成项目交付。
Job Request:
- Be interested in Maintenance Management, project consulting and system 
 implementation;
- Bachelor degree or above;
- Excellent English skills and communication skills
- Electrical engineering or mechanical engineering background, 2 years of 
 working at plant maintenance department is preferred;
- With strong logical thinking and ability to work independently；
- Be a good team player, patient and willing to deliver project on time.
我司是一个创业型公司，你将会享受五险一金、年假、公司Outing、年度体检、周末双休、节假日福利等福利。
没经验，我们don’t care!
怕犯错，我们don’t care！
只要你有热情、激情、热爱这个行业、认真对待工作、想锻炼自己，欢迎加入领值，我们非常乐意培养一个优秀的你，和我们一起搞事情。
加分项
有以下行业经验：计算机软件
